Coram : DIPAK MISRA*, D.Y. CHANDRACHUD, A.M. KHANWILKAR
Representation of People Act, 1951 – ss. 83 and 100(1)(a) and (d)(i), 101 and 125A(i) – Appellant challenged the election of respondent no.1 by filing election petition before the High Court alleging that respondent no.1 several instructions issued by the Election Commission and also the provisions of the Representation of People Act – Respondent no.1, in turn, filed two applications and sought to strike out paragraphs 2 & 9 to 11 of the election petition u/Or. VI, r.16 and to dismiss the election
Decision Date : 21-03-2018 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 9466/2016 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 3 Judges
